d:
Tejashwi Yadav addressed the INDIA Bloc rally at Ramlila Maidan in New Delhi.
During his speech, he launched a sharp attack on Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the central government. Tejashwi described the government as a “2-number government” and PM Modi as a “10-number PM.” His remarks came amid the opposition’s protest and political campaign at Ramlila Maidan.
Watch the video to know what Tejashwi Yadav said at the INDIA Bloc rally.
